views.name: home
views.label: Home View (default)
views.state: fresh browser profile; no localStorage seed; currentView defaults to home

views.name: player
views.label: Player View
views.state: localStorage ui-store-v2 currentView=player (persist envelope v2) + player-store currentSong fixture (稻香 / LRC demo fixture)

views.name: lyrics-fullscreen
views.label: Fullscreen Lyrics View
views.state: same state as Player, then click [title=点击进入全屏歌词] → .fullscreen-lyrics-root

notes: The Next.js dev indicator is hidden with CSS; application UI is not modified.
Player/lyrics use a deterministic demo-song fixture (稻香, LRC from src/services/lyricsSearchService.ts) so protected surfaces show content on a fresh profile.
Console errors are recorded, not fatal; the dev-mode app may log external demo-asset/API network failures.
